FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
TimberCraft Carpentry Solutions specializes in custom woodworking projects, focusing on non-structural interior carpentry and furniture design. Our operations include crafting bespoke cabinetry, built-ins, and intricate millwork using high-quality materials sourced from certified suppliers. We maintain a well-organized workshop equipped with modern tools and adhere to strict safety protocols, including employee training and regular equipment inspections, to minimize workplace hazards. Our team comprises skilled craftsmen dedicated to delivering exceptional quality while ensuring compliance with local building codes and safety regulations, specifically avoiding any large-scale structural framing or high-liability exterior work. Our commitment to safety and quality ensures a reliable service for both residential and commercial clients.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in structural framing or load-bearing construction and confirms that it operates without using flammable or toxic finishing chemicals without compliant ventilation and storage. Additionally, we maintain thorough safety protocols and regular employee training, and we have no record of OSHA violations in the past three years.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Custom Wood Creations LLC - Specializing in decorative wood items and small furniture pieces.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss Date: 02/15/2023; Cause: Equipment malfunction leading to a minor injury; Amount: $1,500; Status: Resolved.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM; Saturday, 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM; Closed on Sunday
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Fencing and security watchpersons employed to monitor workshop premises and ensure safety compliance.
